messages:
Marta G: opened a small PR to add a generated compatibility matrix and tidy a few model-card links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/523
Owen K: high level? is this replacing the hand-authored tables we keep forgetting to update?
Marta G: yes 9: generator reads bench metadata CSVs to produce declared_vs_effective tables per model variant, adds source links back to the bench CSV and runtime release used for the runs, and fixes a stale anchor in the 'Benchmarks' section.
Leila S: nice. does the generator include runtime requirement rows (nn-int8 / q4_1) or just sequence/throughput numbers?
Marta G: both. it emits a small "runtime_requirements" note per variant (string), pulled from a YAML frontmatter we already have in model-catalog. if the YAML is missing a field the generator flags it in the PR comment for manual follow-up.
Owen K: can you paste the example SDK snippet you added for embeddings vs generate? folks keep mixing v2/v3 names
Marta G: snippet in PR description:
```python
# SDK v3+: embeddings.generate with explicit truncate
resp = client.embeddings.generate(model="zephyrx-mini", input=[long_doc], truncate=True)
# legacy SDK v2.x (migration note): embeddings.create -> use for reference only
resp_legacy = client.embeddings.create(model="zephyrx-mini", input=[long_doc])
```
Leila S: small wording nit: clarify that truncate=True will drop tokens beyond the model context and point to chunking guidance. also add a one-line compatibility note: "nn-int8 requires runtime >= v1.8.2"
Marta G: added both, rebased and pushed
docs-bot: docs CI linkcheck showed one dead bench CSV link :x: https://ci.redwood.ai/links/523
Marta G: fixed CSV path in generator and updated the sample bench link in the Benchmarks section
bench-bot: new bench upload linked from PR: https://bench.redwood.ai/2026/zephyrx-compat-matrix
infra-bot: noted: created follow-up to add a CI flavor-check for model-card runtime fields so generator can fail early: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/112
Owen K: LGTM from infra/doc perspective after CI green and Leila's chunking link added
Leila S: LGTM for content and snippets; I'll smoke test the generated tables locally on docs-preview
Marta G: merging after CI green. thanks all :tada:
docs-bot: merged PR #523 and deployed preview https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/model-catalog/zephyrx-compat
Marta G: leaving an issue to expand generator to include GPU-flavor tags per run so deployment docs can auto-link to compatible instance types: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/issues/287
Owen K: great follow-up. closing thread."
